subject: Weekly forecast — Sherpa huddle + submission checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@atlashealth.io>
Cc: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.io>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast — Sherpa huddle + submission checklist

Team / Atlas — quick reminder for today's short cadence: our weekly forecast submission window opens at 1:00pm PT and we have a 15-minute "Sherpa" huddle at 12:15pm PT to triage any last-minute stage changes. Goal is to get AtlasHealth deal moved to Commit with the updated ARR and to confirm NRR assumptions before submission.

Please review the attached forecast template (RWF-forecast-template-v2.xlsx) and add any missing evidence links in column F. For Atlas specifically, confirm the following before the huddle:
- Legal review ETA for SOW (procurement flag)
- Final pricing line (list vs. committed)
- Go-live milestone (used for measurement window)

Draft agenda for 12:15 Sherpa (12:15–12:30):
1) Quick status (owner, stage, ARR ask) — 2m per owner
2) Blockers & evidence check (legal, procurement, tech trial) — 6m
3) Recommended stage action (Commit / Commit at Risk / Hold) — 4m
4) Submission owner & doc links — 3m

If procurement from Atlas needs anything we should surface now, @emma can you confirm procurement's requirements so we can document in the evidence column?

Thanks — see you in 12.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: RWF-forecast-template-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: weekly-call-agenda.pdf (pdf)

- Irene: can you confirm whether revenue recognition will be straight-line or milestone for Atlas?

Hi Ben / team — procurement here. Quick notes from our side: we need a customer-signed SOW + final pricing line (including any early-adopter credits) before legal will approve. We can parallel-path the DocuSign envelope if you send the SOW draft; procurement will review within 48 hours once the draft is received.

Also confirming: billing contact is accounting@atlashealth.io and they prefer NET-30.

I'll aim to have a procurement checklist in the thread before your 12:15 huddle, but if Marissa can include the SOW version and the committed pricing callout in column G that would speed things up.

Thanks —
Emma Li
Senior Procurement Manager, AtlasHealth
emma@atlashealth.io

Note: Procurement will not sign until legal signoff and SOW is final.

Great — thanks for the quick responses. Short update after the huddle and attachments added to the shared space:
- Outcome: Recommend "Commit at Risk" for AtlasHealth (ARR $380,000) because procurement signoff is pending SOW but sales & RevOps validated ARR and trial success metrics.
- Submission owner: Ben Carter (I will hit submit after we attach the SOW placeholder and DocuSign link).
- Evidence: Marissa has uploaded PO scan and trial metrics; Sofia confirmed acceptance criteria met; Irene confirmed straight-line recognition.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Ben: prepare SOW draft and start DocuSign envelope — ETA EOD today
- Marissa: finalize evidence links in column F & add SOW placeholder in column G — ETA 3pm PT
- Emma / Procurement: target legal review within 48 hours once SOW is posted

If anything changes I'm pinging the thread. Otherwise I'll submit the deal into the weekly rollup at 1:00pm PT as "Commit at Risk" and note procurement dependency in the submission comments.

Ben Carter
